stem: Two applicants seek Massachusetts pharmacist licensure by examination. One graduated from an ACPE-accredited school; the other graduated from a non-approved foreign school. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Both applicants must have completed a pharmacy internship in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01(1).
The foreign graduate must have received official FPGEC certification from NABP.
Both applicants must be 18 years of age or older by the scheduled examination date.
FPGEC certification relieves the foreign graduate of the internship requirement.
The ACPE-accredited graduate is exempt from the good moral character requirement.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 3.01(1) and (2) impose the internship requirement, the age requirement measured by the scheduled examination date and the good moral character requirement on both pathways. FPGEC certification substitutes for the accredited degree on the foreign pathway; it does not substitute for the internship.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: the internship requirement applies on both pathways.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: official FPGEC certification from NABP is required on the foreign pathway.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: the age requirement is measured by the scheduled examination date.
choice_analysis.D: FPGEC certification replaces the accredited degree, not the internship.
choice_analysis.E: Good moral character is required on both pathways.

related_facts: The foreign graduate must also submit an official copy of the FPGEC certificate and the Board must receive official NABP notification.
explanation.mpje_trap: FPGEC certification stands in for the accredited degree, not for the internship.

reasoning_steps: Separate the requirements common to both pathways from the pathway-specific ones
Identify what FPGEC certification actually substitutes for
Confirm the internship requirement survives on the foreign pathway
